content.title: Things You Don't Know
content.text: Banksy spent decades as the world's most famous unknown person — and a police report from the year 2000 may have just ended it all.A major Reuters investigation published last week claims to have finally identified Banksy as Robin Gunningham, a 51-year-old from Bristol who later changed his name to David Jones to avoid detection. The evidence includes a handwritten confession from a 2000 arrest in New York, court records, immigration documents tracking his movements to Ukraine, and connections to the Bristol graffiti scene where Banksy first emerged in the 1990s.Banksy's lawyer responded by saying the artist does not accept many of the findings and warned that publishing the report would violate his privacy and put him in danger. His company Pest Control said only that Banksy has decided to say nothing.Whether you wanted the mystery solved or not, this is the closest anyone has ever gotten.All reactions:Larene GradyWhy seek out his true identity. I think part of the major allure of Banksy is that none of us know who they are. I don’t believe this for one second. Rock on, Banksy. Whoever you are!!81David VidovicGuys, if you've seen "Exit through the gift shop", you'll know this is classic Banksy...he's been planning this "report" for decades.4153Andrea DajakWe don't want the world to know who is Banksy... He is all of us!19Chris Villafuerte FloresI love the mystery of it all. Don't give the artist a name or a face. Leave it as BANKSY, faceless, nameless, but extraordinary street art. 69Ryan RattrayLooks like a rough Simon Cowell Christina BaldwinEven if it is him, just let him live his life how he wants. Why do people feel the need to get involved in things that don't affect them. Why the need to get in other people's business. If he doesn't want to be bothered, don't bother him, so simple.92Ted WebbI’m Banksy and so is my wife! (Apologies if some other wag has already put this!)14Michael Danger WebbLeave the be. Not all hero’s wear capes but they all need a secret identity5100
